decision: Use dedicated zone servers for live rules and one authenticated backend for durable state. Client input is a request.
consequence: No client SaveGame authority; server session caches carry fencing epoch and character revision.

decision: C++ owns rule validation, GAS, movement extensions and adapters. Blueprints edit definitions and compose visuals/UI.
consequence: Project custom commands are not built-in Blueprint nodes; read-only runtime access, authority checks even on exposed commands.

decision: Target Unreal Engine 5.8.3; public release verified, local installation/build not verified.
consequence: Pin Build.version/changelist and source build, toolchain and plugin hashes before local acceptance.

decision: ACharacter-based native bodies with Paper2D visual components and a single PaperZD presentation adapter.
consequence: Composition isolates plugin-sensitive code. Confirm the installed Animation Component binding API in Phase 00; no speculative plugin inheritance contract.

decision: Fixed azimuth, elevated restrained perspective, zoom only; true X/Y locomotion with Z height.
consequence: Prototype azimuth 45°, elevation 50°, FOV 35°, zoom arm 900–1600 cm; tune in art lab. Orthographic only after comparison.

decision: Four-direction fallback and common body until archive inspection; eight directions and missing actions are production tasks.
consequence: No paid pixels redistributed, no exact source frames guessed, gameplay equipment coverage independent of visual layer coverage.

decision: Begin with generic actor/property/RPC replication.
consequence: Measure before replacing with Iris OR Replication Graph; never both. Record compatible installed configuration before optimization.

decision: Choose GAS; player ASC on PlayerState, enemy ASC on enemy Character.
consequence: Possession/avatar lifecycle bridge and prediction need two-client proof. No skeletal montage dependency and no separate parallel combat stack.

decision: One ASP.NET Core service on .NET 10 plus PostgreSQL 18, authenticated UE HTTP adapter.
consequence: Compared with TypeScript/Node service: both viable; C# static contracts and long support favor this default. SQL is never accessible to clients.

decision: One DB transaction for each economic command, command receipt, affected rows and durable source claim; fence every server write.
consequence: No DB transaction across an HTTP wait. Persist committed result before replicating success. Cache timeout is unknown, not failure.

decision: ClientTravel connects only the transferring player to an independently hosted destination. Backend ticket redemption changes the fencing epoch.
consequence: Source body remains frozen; old authority is invalidated at redemption, not delayed until visual acknowledgement. This closes a dual-writer window.

decision: Introduce identity/item records, reward receipt and session lock in Phase 05; minimal party/credit contract in Phase 08.
consequence: Full inventory UI in 09 and full social UX in 19. Phase 08 cannot depend on future item identity or party definitions.

decision: Exclusive transient action reservation, followed by atomic durable depleted-generation claim and reward.
consequence: Losing player receives ResourceBusy or NodeDepleted. Reservations alone never award items.

decision: Server-owned attempt, bite window and terminal receipt; deterministic client visuals from accepted times.
consequence: Missed/late cosmetic notify cannot authorize catch. Restart cancels unresolved attempts; committed catches survive.

decision: Deterministic output at first; all material, currency, item and profession changes commit together.
consequence: No failure roll initially. Batch limits and per-command output identity prevent duplication.

decision: Initially party-shared kill credit with equal XP split among eligible nearby members, and personal loot allocations.
consequence: Record contribution/eligibility at defeat; eligible solo outsiders receive no party loot. Named encounter rules may later override.

decision: 15 logical positions: Head, Chest, Legs, Hands, Feet, Waist, Shoulders, Cloak, MainHand, OffHand, Neck, Ring1/2, Trinket1/2.
consequence: Chest/Top and Legs/Pants are aliases. Stats remain valid when a visual mapping is missing. Two-handed gear excludes OffHand.

decision: Retain inventory, XP and quests; safe shrine respawn, remove short harmful effects, reinitialize resources under one recovery policy.
consequence: Default 5% equipped durability loss, no inventory wipe; penalty command is idempotent. Reconnect is not a free respawn/heal.

decision: 24 phases, three slices, six zone-family designs; only two graybox zones required for Slice A.
consequence: No claim of thousands of players. Guilds/dungeons/trade later committed; PvP, raids, housing, auctions and monetization optional gates.

decision: Stable definition IDs, UUIDs for owned nonstackables/characters, integers for quantities and base currency.
consequence: Authoring IDs survive renames via migration aliases. No localization strings or asset display names as database identity.

decision: Original world of the Talarin Reach, with river, forest, marsh, highland, mountain and coast regions.
consequence: Original working names are not trademark-cleared. Do not reproduce protected fantasy names, maps or dialogue.

decision: No daily resets or escort production in initial core; define extension gates rather than silently enable.
consequence: Repeatable quests opt in with server cycle IDs; escort needs navigation, disconnect, reset and party-credit proof.

decision: Replace main only after validated documentation generation; retain existing history and a backup reference.
consequence: Generating a ZIP is separate from publication; final report must state actual remote commit or failure.

decision: Delivered documentation is an evidence-labeled draft, not an acceptance-complete manual while the archive and installed APIs remain unavailable.
consequence: Static/browser results are independent of Unreal, database, packaged or multiplayer runtime results.
